boxes.meaning: urge or advise someone to do something

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for earnestly advising or recommending something.
This is the all-purpose choice for trying to persuade someone to do something.
Use this for urging or advising someone to do something, especially when the emphasis is on the attempt rather than the result.
Use this when persuasion or urging leads a person to do something, rather than causing an event or condition.
Use this when the advice is urging or persuading someone to take or avoid a particular action.

examples.english: I often preach the benefits of working from home.
examples.traditional: 我成日勸人返工喺屋企做。
